causal_change.factor: Compositional scope of anchor-native responsibility binding across causal-preimage edges
causal_change.before: The binder selects the first grounded anchor-native responsibility site for each fixed preimage node independently, then annotates that node with ingress, egress, authority, lifecycle, and downstream handoff facts; adjacent node records need not prove that the upstream egress and downstream ingress are the same causal value at one concrete transfer boundary.
causal_change.after: The binder traverses the same fixed nodes once in dependency order and emits one closure-wide custody map: a node site is admitted under the champion's existing first-grounded-site rule only together with one source-grounded custody record for every incident fixed edge, making the upstream egress predicate, existing transport or first missing handoff boundary, downstream ingress predicate, value identity, and authority transfer compose into one uninterrupted prerequisite-to-terminal chain.
causal_change.why_causal: The preimage's causal force resides in its edges: satisfying two endpoint predicates at unrelated sites does not ensure that the value produced by the prerequisite is the value consumed downstream. Closure-wide custody changes only the compositional scope of the same binding operation. The terminal witness, preimage nodes and edges, dependency order, single-trace lifecycle scope, number of node sites, source-authoring boundary, implementation freedom, candidate lineage, and final decision stay fixed. Edge custody records are necessary manifestations of this one admission rule, not extra targets, traces, candidates, samples, reviews, or gates.

hypothesis.expected_effect: The sole final producer should receive one causally closed producer-to-consumer custody chain instead of separately reasonable node records whose joins must be inferred during coding. This should reduce mismatched state versions, representation drift, duplicate writers, lost refreshes at subsystem boundaries, and locally valid but end-to-end disconnected implementations while preserving the champion's supported outcome-first whole-system construction. Under the frozen matched protocol this predicts zero invalid accepted arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsify the refinement unless the frozen matched batch completes three valid pairs with zero invalid accepted arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo. Mechanistically falsify it if the binder changes the witness, nodes, edges, dependency order, or champion lifecycle scope; derives a lifecycle-dominance closure; emits more than one site, custody map, lineage, or engine; generates or ranks alternate transports; authors source or ordered edits; or acts as a reviewer or gate. Also falsify it if the final producer rebinds a node or edge, introduces another target or causal closure, arbitrates among implementations, or returns more than one complete engine.
hypothesis.behavioral_novelty: Before any candidate source exists, the loop can now establish that every unchanged causal edge has continuous custody from its bound producer through one concrete anchor-native handoff to its bound consumer. Fan-in and fan-out records share the same value identity and authority epoch, and a missing existing transfer is localized to the first fixed boundary as one obligation in the same map. The champion can list node-local handoff facts but cannot require all of them to compose into a single closed chain; R26 broadens lifecycle-path coverage rather than coupling adjacent bindings.
strengths: Preserves the supported outcome-preimage family, sole terminal witness, unchanged minimal backward closure, pre-authoring anchor-native site commitment, untouched anchor authority, single working lineage, and exactly one final engine.
Targets the champion's explicit incomplete-handoff and duplicated-state risks without relying on the invalid/incomplete lifecycle-dominance evidence or changing lifecycle coverage.

Makes independently grounded responsibility records compose across subsystem boundaries, which generalizes to compilers, services, agents, data pipelines, and stateful search systems while remaining useful for ordinary search-state, repetition, timing, and protocol handoffs.

Uses one deterministic dependency-order pass and one custody record per already fixed edge, with no replicated agents, candidates, components, traces, samples, alternatives, rankings, arbitration, or best-of-N selection.
risks: A source-grounded custody relation can be described too strictly when the anchor intentionally reconstructs an equivalent value rather than transporting one representation directly.
At fan-in or fan-out, requiring one identity and authority epoch may choose a broader common boundary than the simplest implementation and can overconstrain the final producer.
The custody map adds edge-level context within the same four-call ceiling and may distract the final producer when the champion's node records already imply the handoffs clearly.

A first missing handoff boundary is an obligation rather than proof of an existing transport; the sole final producer may still fail to realize that edge without disturbing behavior outside the fixed closure.

structure.name: Custody-Composed Anchor-Bound Outcome-Preimage Realization
structure.information_flow: The task, one supplied anchor, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, hypothesis, and loop contract enter the champion's single non-authoring terminal-witness role, which commits exactly one anchor-negative terminal postcondition. That witness and the byte-identical anchor enter the champion's single non-authoring causal backchainer, which fixes one minimal implementation-neutral prerequisite closure. The same anchor, witness, and unchanged closure enter one non-authoring custody-composition binder, which retains the champion's single grounded-trace lifecycle scope while binding every node once and every fixed causal edge once into one source-grounded producer-to-consumer custody chain without proposing source mutations. The untouched anchor and sole custody-bound preimage enter one final whole-system producer, which realizes those node and edge obligations in one working lineage and emits the only complete engine.

calls.role: single terminal-outcome witness committer under gpt-5.6-luna/high Fast-priority runtime
calls.objective: Inspect exactly one supplied anchor, the task, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, hypothesis, and loop contract. Establish a deterministic priority order over task-general externally observable obligations such as legality, protocol behavior, bounded work, state integrity, and decision quality, then commit exactly the first obligation for which one bounded reproducible procedure yields a concrete anchor-negative terminal postcondition. Return one WITNESS record containing the procedure, inputs stated generically rather than as benchmark cases, observed anchor trace, failed terminal predicate, preservation predicates, and falsifier. This is evidence acquisition only: do not emit engine source, a patch, ordered edits, an implementation contract, a strength mechanism or component, a seam surrogate, a fixture collection, alternative targets, a menu, a ranking, or implementation advice. Do not inspect benchmark positions or evaluator internals and do not prescribe engine-hyperparameter tuning.

calls.role: single implementation-neutral causal-preimage backchainer under gpt-5.6-luna/high Fast-priority runtime
calls.objective: Consume the untouched supplied anchor and the sole terminal_outcome_witness. Starting at its failed terminal predicate, trace actual control and state dependencies backward and emit exactly one minimal PREIMAGE_CLOSURE: the terminal node, typed prerequisite nodes and edges, anchor facts grounding every edge, node-level satisfaction predicates, a preservation boundary, a deterministic dependency order, and any explicit unresolved assumption. Collapse equivalent dependencies and use first-dependency order so no alternative closure is generated or compared. The closure defines what must become true, not where or how source should be edited. Do not emit source code, patches, ordered source-edit operations, a complete or provisional engine, a standalone component, seam surrogate, graft instructions, multiple closures, implementation candidates, samples, rankings, reviewer verdicts, or best-of-N selection.

calls.role: single non-authoring causal-edge custody binder under gpt-5.6-luna/high Fast-priority runtime
calls.objective: Consume the byte-identical supplied anchor, the sole terminal_outcome_witness, and the sole causal_preimage_backchainer closure. Preserve the terminal node, prerequisite nodes, causal edges, predicates, preservation boundary, and dependency order exactly. Preserve the champion's bounded single grounded-trace lifecycle scope; do not derive a lifecycle transition closure, require cross-path lifecycle dominance, or import the invalid R26 refinement. Traverse the fixed dependency order exactly once. Bind every node to exactly one existing anchor-native responsibility site using the champion's first-grounded-site rule, except that a site is admitted only as part of the same closure-wide compositional pass: for every fixed edge whose incident sites become bound, record exactly one EDGE_CUSTODY entry that identifies the prerequisite value and authority epoch, upstream egress predicate and event, existing anchor-native alias/copy/transport path, downstream ingress predicate and event, ownership or read-authority transfer, and anchor evidence that the consumer receives the same causal value. At fan-in or fan-out, reuse one value identity rather than creating variants. If no existing transport discharges an edge, retain the first grounded endpoint sites and record exactly the first source-order handoff boundary as one OPEN_CUSTODY_OBLIGATION in that edge's same record; do not add a preimage node or edge, branch, query another role, invent an alternate transport, or compare sites. Emit exactly one CUSTODY_BOUND_PREIMAGE containing the one site per node and one custody record per fixed edge. Existing symbols may be named only to ground responsibility and transport facts. Do not author source, patches, edit sequences, algorithms, parameter values, a lifecycle-dominance map, component, seam surrogate, graft, alternate map, candidate, engine, sample, review, verdict, gate, ranking, or best-of-N selection.

calls.role: single custody-composed outcome-preimage whole-engine producer under gpt-5.6-luna/high Fast-priority runtime
calls.objective: Treat champion_engine as the untouched supplied source authority, terminal_outcome_witness as the sole authorized terminal target, causal_preimage_backchainer as the complete authorized causal boundary, and causal_edge_custody_binder as the sole authorized node and edge map. Produce exactly one complete legal production engine in one working lineage by realizing every unchanged prerequisite at its one bound anchor-native site and carrying its value through every fixed EDGE_CUSTODY record to the bound consumer, beginning with deepest prerequisites and propagating forward to the terminal node. At an OPEN_CUSTODY_OBLIGATION, realize exactly that handoff predicate at its recorded existing boundary; do not choose another boundary, rebind an endpoint, or add a causal target. Choose the concrete implementation algorithm only inside this call, preserve behavior outside the fixed closure, and retain the champion's lifecycle scope. Replay the same terminal witness and check every node predicate and edge custody identity, plus bounded syntax, public source-contract, UCI, legal-move, state-integrity, determinism, timing-safety, and perft checks where applicable. If a check fails, trace it to the earliest unmet fixed node or custody edge, repair only that obligation or its authorized edge in the same working engine, and replay forward. Do not derive another witness, preimage, lifecycle closure, binding map, or implementation lineage; create a standalone component, seam surrogate, graft, edit-program interpreter, intermediate or alternative engine, candidate variant, sample, reviewer, selector, gate, preserve-versus-rollback arbitration, clean-room replacement, global normalization, benchmark-specific logic, or engine-hyperparameter tuning as the structural change. Return exactly one complete engine as the sole engine artifact.
